_readme: Tier-2 GROUPED reskins (Addendum B §3.1) — the FIN, PPL, OPP, LIF, K and LGL
events the Tier-1 passes skipped. Same contract as reskins.json: keyed by
event id, then industry code, each string replacing GameEvent.text wholesale.
Every rule in that file's _readme binds here unchanged.
THE GROUPED MODEL: these events don't need twelve versions — industries
cluster. Each event carries FOUR variants, mapped onto all twelve codes:
PHYSICAL  FOOD ECOM FASHION BEAUTY TOYS PET SUSTAIN — inventory, shipping,
shelf, unit vocabulary
DIGITAL   TECH GAMING EDTECH — users, uptime, platform, launch vocabulary
AUDIENCE  CONTENT — views, sponsors, algorithm
SERVICE   FITNESS — members, floor, schedule
Duplicated strings inside a group are BY DESIGN — the schema stays
per-industry so any single code can later graduate to its own line without
touching the others.
SELECTION: the ~25 highest-weight industries:"all" events in these
categories with no reskin in the other three files. Figures the choices lean
on survive verbatim in every variant: E-FIN-001's 8S/12%, E-FIN-006's
6 weeks, K-MKT-1's 60%/−70%, K-SUP-1's 10 days, E-FIN-011's 92 cents,
E-OPP-008's 2S, E-FIN-002's 5S, E-FIN-012's and E-LGL-003's 3S.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT:
E-FIN-003 — top weight, but reskins.json's _readme already rules it out:
the 6S invoice is the event, and the choices lean on it. Same call here.
E-WLD-* — nothing skipped for numbers; all WILD events weigh 1–2 and sit
below the cut. K-*-2/3 steps likewise (weight 1, scheduled not drawn) —
the chain STARTERS carry the reskin and the steps inherit the situation.
